label: Supabase
description: Supabase project keys (service_role, anon, secret, publishable), personal access tokens, and project hosts.

signals.reason: A service_role key skips row level security. It reads and changes all data of the project.
A secret key (sb_secret_) skips row level security. It reads and changes all data of the project.
The anon key is public in the browser. Row level security limits what it can do.
A publishable key (sb_publishable_) is public in the browser. Row level security limits what it can do.
A personal access token (sbp_) manages every project of the account. It can delete a project and its data.
The variable name says service_role. That key skips row level security.
The variable name says anon. The anon key is public, and row level security limits it.
The item name or a label names Supabase.
A host of the item is a Supabase host.
